title: Testing 432 Hz Frequencies (and temperaments)
summary: Adam Neely tests the claims for tuning to A=432 Hz by trying the unusual tuning systems that its proponents' numerology requires. He compares how they sound against standard tuning and temperaments.
why: HN points to it whenever the 432 Hz versus 440 Hz debate or tuning systems come up, and as an accessible entry point to music theory for non-musicians.

quote.text: As someone who hasn't taken any musical theory or similar, it was quite interesting to hear.
